Name: Haley Off-The-Shoulder Dress
Author: Ahrimhan
Description:
[size=5][center]Haley Off-The-Shoulder Dress[/center][/size]
[size=3]To me, something about Haley's dress always looked weird. In previous versions she used to wear a different one but just replacing her portrait with the old one would not fit the current style, so I decided to tweak it a little.

[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/DiZ0VCb.png[/img]


[size=3]And to keep it all consistent, I also added some blue pixels to her sprite.[/size]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vpRra9X.png[/img]


[size=3]Update: Added an alternative version of the sprite, with more visible shoulders, under optional files.[/size]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/SeINDy7.png[/img]


[size=2][b]Installation:
[/b]1. Make sure to make a backup of Content/Characters/Haley.xnb and Content/Portraits/Haley.xnb, as this mod replaces these files
2. Extract the archive into your Content folder, or replace the .xnb's inside the respective folders yourself, if you want only the portrait or the sprite[/size]
